create.name: Tara Mandala
create.bio:
Tara Mandala is a Tibetan Buddhist retreat centre and international practice community set on 700 acres of mountain land near Pagosa Springs in south-western Colorado. Lama Tsultrim Allione, among the first American women to take ordination as a Tibetan Buddhist nun, founded it in 1993, and what began with a single canvas yurt is now a campus with a three-storey temple, cabins for solitary retreat and a worldwide network of local sanghas. Its teaching gives a central place to the sacred feminine and to the lineage of Machig Labdrön, the eleventh-century Tibetan woman teacher of Chöd, and it welcomes people of every background.

On the land it hosts group retreats, from short programmes to long immersions, and individual retreats in solitary cabins. Much of the teaching also happens online, through Zoom courses and yana, its digital Dharma hub, where self-paced programmes on Green Tara, Zhitro, the Heart Sutra and Chöd sit alongside live practice groups. Students can follow long-term study paths such as Magyu, the Mother Lineage, the Ösel Nyingtig luminosity path and a Gateway programme, or train in Feeding Your Demons, the five-step practice Lama Tsultrim developed for meeting inner struggle with compassion. A yearlong introduction, The Heart of Buddhism, covers the core teachings, and scholarships widen access.

courses.title: Zhitro Practice Revisited
courses.description: An online daylong with Lopön Polly Ryan for people who have already received the Zhitro transmission: group practice of the sadhana, which is done on behalf of those who have died, with further teaching and time for questions.

courses.title: The Heart of Buddhism: The Awakened Heart
courses.description: Five Friday sessions on Zoom taught by Zoketsu Norman Fischer, Lopön Karla Jackson-Brewer and Dorje Lopön Chandra Easton; the third course of the centre's yearlong Heart of Buddhism series on the Buddha's path and taking refuge.

courses.title: The Heart of Buddhism: Sacred View Sacred World
courses.description: The fourth course of the Heart of Buddhism series, taught online by Dorje Lopön Charlotte Rotterdam over five Fridays, with the option of formally taking the Refuge Vow.

courses.title: The Heart of Buddhism: The Great Perfection
courses.description: The closing course of the Heart of Buddhism year, on Dzogchen, taught on Zoom across five Fridays by Sangye Khandro, Tulku Ösel Dorje and Lama Tsultrim Allione.

free_resources.title: Tibetan Buddhism for Beginners
free_resources.description: An introductory guide to shamatha and vipashyana meditation and to the Feeding Your Demons process, with a video of Lama Tsultrim Allione giving calm-abiding instructions.
